beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I covered your lunch yesterday. Bring back the ten minutes I spent queuing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That covers the sandwich. I'm only asking for my time back.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can queue for you today.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then join yesterday's queue ahead of me. Hand me the sandwich before I waste ten minutes. That settles both parts.

reason: Original A5 repeats retrieving the old minutes without making concrete use of the offered queue service. The revision turns B4's queue offer into retroactive delivery before A's wait.
comparison: The time alternative now specifies an impossible past queue intervention; the moon alternative bargains over repeated duration of a physical impossibility.
scope: Local writer revision only; no technical retries or fresh-review correction counters changed.
